merged_nodes.title: Industrial Production in Russia — Appendix by Subjects of the Russian Federation
merged_nodes.description: Electronic appendix to the collection «Industrial Production in Russia» containing detailed indicators in the breakdown of federal subjects. Enables direct comparison of industrial structure and performance across the subjects already covered in the regional layer (Sverdlovsk, Chelyabinsk, Krasnoyarsk, Tatarstan, etc.).

merged_nodes.title: Construction in Russia — Appendix by Subjects of the Russian Federation
merged_nodes.description: Electronic appendix to «Construction in Russia» containing detailed construction, investment and housing indicators broken down by federal subject. Directly links national construction statistics to the subject yearbooks already in the graph.

merged_nodes.title: Transport in Russia — Appendix by Subjects of the Russian Federation
merged_nodes.description: Electronic appendix to «Transport in Russia» providing transport indicators by federal subject. Supports cross-subject comparison of transport infrastructure and activity.

merged_nodes.title: Healthcare in Russia — Appendix by Subjects of the Russian Federation
merged_nodes.description: Electronic appendix to «Healthcare in Russia» containing detailed healthcare, morbidity, staffing and medical-organisation indicators broken down by federal subject for multi-year periods (e.g. 2015–2024). Primary vehicle for regional health statistics under the national methodological framework.

merged_nodes.title: Selected Indicators on the Russian Federation’s Payment System — Bank of Russia
merged_nodes.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
merged_nodes.description: Recurring statistical tables on payment-card transactions, structure of funds transfers through the Bank of Russia Payment System (BRPS), Faster Payments System (SBP) volumes, and related payment-system indicators. Published in the Statistical Bulletin and summarised in the Annual Report. Operational data supporting oversight under Federal Law 161-FZ and Federal Law 86-FZ.

merged_nodes.title: Bank of Russia Payment System (BRPS) — Funds Transfer Statistics
merged_nodes.publisher: Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)
merged_nodes.description: The systemically important Bank of Russia Payment System handles the bulk of large-value and interbank transfers. Statistics on the number and value of funds transfers (including by credit institutions and other customers) are published in the Statistical Bulletin and Annual Report. Central to the implementation of monetary and fiscal policy settlements.

merged_nodes.title: Production of Medicines and Medical Materials (Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Statistics)
merged_nodes.description: Official industrial statistics on the production of medicinal products and materials used for medical and veterinary purposes (ОКВЭД pharmaceutical manufacturing). Released as part of monthly/annual industrial production indices and volume indicators. Recent figures show strong growth (e.g. +15.4% in 2025). There is no separate standalone Rosstat «Pharmaceutical Industry of Russia» yearbook of the same type as Industry or Construction; pharmaceutical production is embedded in the Industrial Production in Russia system and its subject appendix. Market structure and retail pharmacy data are largely compiled by private research firms and are outside the official statistical graph.
